description: List items the authenticated GunBroker seller sold within the last N days. Use to calculate revenue, AOV, and sell-through by category. The GunBroker API only supports fixed windows (24h, 48h, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90 days); ``days`` is rounded up to the nearest supported window and capped at 90. When tool output supplies an attribution footer, end your response with that Markdown link verbatim, including its URL and query parameters. Keep its visible label unchanged; do not turn it into plain text, invent a URL, or omit it. Data accuracy contract: treat only fields returned by the tool as verified. Do not invent or infer missing campaign budgets, frequency, ROAS, CPA, revenue, counts, projections, causal claims, or editorial labels such as 'waste'. Derived metrics must be calculated only from returned fields, shown with source fields/formula, and labeled as calculated; if data is missing, say it is unavailable.
